text: What does the acronym WYSIWYG stand for?
choices: What You See Is What You Get
Where You See Is Where You Go
Who You See Is Who You Get
What You Say Is What You Get
explanation: KompoZer provides a web page editor which has a simple graphical interface known as WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get).

text: Which Java keyword is used to create a new object?
explanation: The keyword 'new' is used to create the object by allocating memory.

text: What is the primary use of the 'R' software?
explanation: R is a free software environment for statistical computing.

text: In an HTML form, which attribute specifies the filename where data is sent?
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data... It takes a filename as value.

text: What is the index of the first element in a Java array?
explanation: Index specifies the position of an element in an array... Index value starts from 0.

text: Which software is used to play audio and video files?
explanation: VLC media player... provides several options for playback of audio and video.

text: Which HTML tag is used to create a text box for user input?
explanation: The tag <input> ... is used to implement this element. The input tag has different attributes like type....

text: In Java, which symbol is used for a single-line comment?
explanation: Single-line comment: It begins with double slashes (//).

text: Google Maps is a service primarily used for:
explanation: Google Maps... It can be used to search for a place and find its exact location... find directions.

text: Which attribute of the form tag specifies the HTTP method (GET or POST)?
explanation: The method attribute specifies the HTTP method to be used when sending the data.

text: What is the file extension for a compiled Java file?
explanation: When the program gets compiled... compiler creates a file with extension .class.

text: Which tool allows you to insert special characters like Gujarati letters?
explanation: The Character Map program... can be used to enter Unicode characters into any application.

text: In KompoZer, which tab allows you to see the HTML source code?
explanation: The Source tab shows all details of the HTML code.

text: RationalPlan is software used for?
explanation: RationalPlan is an open source software designed to assist project managers.

text: Which HTML input type is used for a password field?
explanation: Password: Creates a password field... the characters are not displayed to the user.

text: What is a 'Class' in Java?
explanation: A class is a template for multiple objects with similar features.

text: Skype is primarily used for?
explanation: The Skype service allows users to communicate with peers using voice, video as well as text.

text: Which tag creates a submit button in a form?
explanation: Submit: Creates a submit button... <INPUT TYPE = "submit" ...>.

text: In the R software, what command is used to quit?
explanation: Based on the exercise section: Which command is used to quit from R? ... (b) q().

text: Which HTML tag is used for multi-line text input?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag <textarea>... is used.

text: What is the default value of an integer variable in a Java array?
explanation: As array is an object, so its elements are initialized with default values (0 for int).

text: What does Archive Manager do?
explanation: Archive Manager permits us to combine many files... into a single file... and compress the file.

text: Which view in KompoZer shows the page as it would appear in a browser?
explanation: The Preview mode offers the page view as seen in a browser.

text: Which Java package contains the `Date` class?
explanation: Java library also provides Date class in java.util package.

text: What allows you to select multiple items in a form?
explanation: Checkbox: Creates checkboxes in the form. Multiple check boxes can be selected at a time.

text: What prompt symbol does R use to wait for a command?
explanation: The screenshot shows commands entered after the '>' symbol.

text: Which button allows you to create a new file in KompoZer?
explanation: To create a new file... click File -> New (or use the New icon).

text: What is the extension for a Cascading Style Sheet file?
explanation: It also supports the use of 'Styles' through Cascading Style Sheet (CSS).

text: Which Java method is used to sort an array?
explanation: We can use sort() method to sort entire or part of array.

text: What does the `tar` format stand for?
explanation: On Linux systems, tar (tape archiver) is the most common archive format.
